upper_flower_cluster.description: A wide dense umbel of white bell-shaped or cup-shaped flowers with vivid red interiors/tips, rendered with fine pen strokes. The cluster fans broadly across the upper half of the folio from approximately center to right edge. Multiple individual florets on thin stems branch from two main upward stalks. The red coloring is distinctive and consistent across all florets.

left_small_plant.description: A smaller secondary plant on the left side, with broad rounded basal leaves rendered in a pale green wash and a single upright stem bearing one white daisy-like flower. Noticeably smaller scale than the main plant. Roots not clearly shown.

main_plant_left_stem.description: The left of the two primary plant stems. Rises from the intertwined root mass at bottom-center. Bears large pinnately-lobed or deeply-serrated bright green leaves arranged alternately. The stem is pale tan/ivory. Leaves are broad with rounded lobes painted in medium green.

main_plant_right_stem.description: The right of the two primary stems. Rises parallel to the left stem, also from the common root mass. Bears similar pinnate green foliage. At the apex it connects to the upper flower cluster. Slightly taller and more dominant than the left stem.

intertwined_root_system.description: A large and dramatically rendered entangled root mass in reddish-brown. The roots of both main stems and the small left plant merge and loop around each other in a complex knot at the base of the folio. Multiple thick and thin tendrils extend outward and downward. Occupies the lower-center of the folio.

left_margin_text_strip.description: A vertical column of Voynich text written perpendicular to the main text, running along the extreme left gutter/binding margin. Appears to be several lines of continuous script rotated 90 degrees, likely continuation text from a facing page or marginalia annotation.

mid_folio_text_block.description: A secondary embedded paragraph block positioned in the middle zone of the folio, between the two large plant stems and surrounded by foliage on both sides. Text wraps around the root/stem forms of both plants.

text_blocks_mapping.description: The primary paragraph block occupying the upper portion of the folio, above and partially overlapping the upper flower cluster. Lines 1–16 form a continuous paragraph starting with @P0 at top-left and running across the full text width, wrapping around and below the floral umbel on the right.

isolated_zones.description: The dense floral umbel occupying x=320–980, y=30–420 is entirely free of main text. The paragraph text block hugs the left and center of the folio, never entering the flower zone. The flower cluster acts as a hard right-column exclusion zone for lines 1–7.

The large entangled root mass at the bottom of the folio (y=780–1000) contains no text whatsoever. The final text lines stop at approximately y=726, leaving a clear negative space of ~270 normalized units above the bottom edge occupied entirely by the illustrated roots.

The left-margin text (x=0–60) runs vertically and is clearly separate from the main paragraph block. It is written perpendicular to the folio baseline and occupies space that the main text block intentionally avoids. Possibly a reader's annotation or continuation from the facing verso page.

The small secondary plant at left-center (x=90–310, y=360–640) is surrounded by text on its right side (lines 8–11 skirt its right edge) but the plant interior and left side are text-free. The text block shifts slightly rightward to accommodate the plant's foliage extent.
